entries: {SOMEONE:human,!plural} was found at {landmark}, and {first} noticed one thing wrong.
{THING:!living,!bulky} turned up {HIDING}, and its owner was long dead.
{MESSAGE:physical} came from {SOMEONE:human,!plural}: I know who, meet at {landmark}.
{DISASTER:manmade} struck {place}, and the {rival} closed the inquiry by noon.
{SOMEONE:!plural} begged {first} {MANNER} to clear the name of {CLOSE:human}.
{first} found {THING:portable} at {landmark} where nothing should have been.
